topic: Endometriosis pain — the inflammatory pathway explained
caption: 🌟 Did you know 1 in 10 women suffer from endometriosis? 💔 It's time to understand the inflammatory pathway behind this debilitating condition. 📚 Endometriosis occurs when tissue similar to the lining inside the uterus grows outside of it, causing pain and inflammation. 🔬 Research shows that 80% of women with endometriosis have elevated levels of inflammatory markers like TNF-alpha and IL-1beta. 🌈 Save this so you don't lose it.
